result_of: Read-only 7-day classification of existing public archived race IDs and available race metadata
limitations: 597 observed calendar links are not a nationally certified complete count
G3 48 race IDs are classified by verified Tachikawa event; their detailed racecards were not materialized
No rider results, payouts, pre-race odds, feature vintages, or training-ready rows were validated
Raw manifest is in the 7-day Actions artifact, not a permanent dataset store
No new website scraping and no model retraining took place
